policies.text: A carrier receives preferred transit status when holding top-tier safety compliance.
An agency is eligible for city service procurement upon obtaining preferred transit status.
A shuttle agency gains recognized alpine transport endorsement provided it holds valid cold-season transit authorization.
A railway carrier achieves expedited freight service status by maintaining a quarterly punctuality metric of 90 percent or higher.
A car rental company earns eco-fleet certification when electric vehicles represent at least 40 percent of its total inventory.
A transit contract for regional educational transport shall be assigned to an operator eligible for city service procurement that provides performance guarantee indemnity of at least $5,000,000.
A maritime charter company obtains deep-sea navigation clearance if it conducts 15 crew emergency drills annually.

A transport provider achieves top-tier safety compliance when maintaining an annual vehicle safety inspection rating of at least 95 percent across national operations alongside at least 10 annual driver instruction seminars.
